name: Data.eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta
summary: If F ≠ 0, take a point g where |F| is near its maximum (exists_near_max: away from the cusps, first minimum bounded below); there the F♮ combinations approximate K₀ (exists_fNatural_approx) and the reproducing formula writes the needed kernels through tableTheta; the hypothesis makes the integrals vanish, and isolation gives |K₀(1)| ≤ 4εB^{7ν} + ε, a contradiction.

steps.lean:

    D.fitsParams_auxPair _ j, exists_fNatural_approx j

    obtain ⟨⟨_, e'⟩, _, J, k, _⟩ := (_ ∘ₗ _).surjective_of_injective

      G.exists_isJointHarmonic
    erw [← e', (exists_theta_to_principalForms ..).choose_spec j.2]
    simpa [θ, AuxPair.conjKernel, classSum, Rat.smul_def] using! (.sum _ fun _ ↦
      isAdelicHol_pairTheta (mem_holomorphicData_of_highestVector (_ ∘ₗ _) (J · |>.gap.1)
      (realPairWeil_harmonicPoly _) (congr(polyVector _
      $k).substr (prod_mem_holomorphicData o paramW_lt_of_orderW_lt (J · |>.2) rfl).2)) ·)

steps.claim: F is the image of a form of principal level under θ∘θ* (the composite is surjective onto good forms since the lift is injective: self_comp_adjoint_injective_iff), and a jointly harmonic datum (exists_isJointHarmonic).

obtain ⟨⟨_, e'⟩, _, J, k, _⟩ := (_ ∘ₗ _).surjective_of_injective

    (untwistedAuxPair j).ord (-1) ∘ nablaBasis ℂ _ (untwistedAuxPair j).colsMinus)
